newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 cement demand seen at 520 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 cement demand seen at 520 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's demand for cement was expected to be 520 million tonnes in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
Domestic annual production capacity for cement was about 560 million tonnes, the newspaper said, adding that high quality cement was still in short supply due to China's lagging production levels.
Cement exports were estimated at more than 10 million tonnes in 1997, it said.
China planned to build 1.2 billion square metres (12.9 billion square ft) of urban housing each year up to 2000, further spurring cement demand, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
